profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack Systems | AI & Data Applications | Research Software | Geospatial & Environmental Technology
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer focused on building data-intensive applications, AI-enabled systems, and research-oriented software.
Over the past 6+ years, I've worked across the full software development lifecycle—from designing user-facing applications and APIs to working with complex datasets, databases, cloud infrastructure, testing, deployment, and system modernization.

My professional experience includes React, TypeScript, C#/.NET, SQL, REST APIs, cloud platforms, and data-driven application development.

I'm increasingly focused on the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and scientific/research applications. At my current organization, I'm exploring practical approaches to AI-assisted software development, including evaluating AI standards and GitHub Copilot use cases, documenting AI applications, and developing reusable skills and integrations for AI-enabled engineering workflows.

Outside of my primary work, I build research-oriented projects involving:
• Computer vision and machine learning
• Geospatial data and mapping
• Satellite imagery and environmental monitoring
• Archaeological research technology
• Data visualization and decision-support systems
• AI/RAG and emerging developer tooling

I'm particularly interested in research software engineering—the engineering infrastructure that allows scientists, researchers, and technical organizations to turn complex data and research methods into reliable, usable software.
I'm also developing a security-first software factory concept for building reproducible research applications and data-intensive systems. The goal is to combine modern software engineering, AI-assisted development, reusable tooling, automation, testing, and secure-by-design practices into a repeatable engineering workflow.
I'm interested in opportunities where software engineering intersects with scientific research, AI, environmental systems, geospatial technology, national security, and other technically challenging domains.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Dec 2019 – Present
• Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications supporting complex agricultural and regulatory datasets and organizational workflows.
• Develop user-facing applications using React and TypeScript alongside backend services and APIs built with C#/.NET and related technologies.
• Design and implement REST APIs, database queries, and data services supporting internal and customer-facing applications.
• Modernize legacy software and architecture while helping migrate on-premises resources and systems toward cloud-based infrastructure.
• Collaborate directly with users and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical software workflows, including search, filtering, batching, reporting, and data-management functionality.
• Contribute to application architecture, implementation, testing, debugging, deployment, and ongoing system improvement across the software development lifecycle.
• Helped redesign and implement major review-system workflows, improving how users process and manage complex regulatory information.
• Develop reporting and decision-support interfaces that make organizational data more accessible and actionable.
• Currently exploring organizational adoption of AI-assisted software development, including AI standards, GitHub Copilot use cases, documentation, reusable agent skills, and secure AI-enabled engineering workflows.
• Developing security-first patterns for integrating AI, automation, reusable tooling, and external services into software development workflows.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, identify technical solutions, and implement custom features to improve the user experience and streamline internal workflows.
-Managed full software development lifecycle, including planning, design, implementation, testing, and deployment, using agile methodologies.
-Built and maintained databases, API endpoints, and integrations with third-party systems.
-Maintained code quality and reliability through testing, debugging, and code reviews.
-Worked with team to maintain and refactor proprietary software based on OMRI’s goals and business rules.
-Reviewed technical designs of peers' code and tests, while also giving supportive and feedback.

positions.title: Information Technology Technician
positions.description:
Information Technician, Eugene, Oregon - Aug 2015 to Dec 2018 -
-Family Owned Business
-Handled creative direction of marketing projects from the initial concept through design and implementation.
-Installed, maintained and supported application programs for administrative, web and mobile systems using SQUARE, Quickbooks and related tools.
-Developed previous iterations of company websites and company advertisements
